summary: Preserved candidate PR 2914's single-rank parallel component scheduler and corrected the independently reviewed serialization defect at exact candidate commit 1baf5337c192902f8f19b56e05d713945b5ab4ff. The candidate held model_construction_lock around the complete native from_pretrained operation; an independent probe reproduced max_active_native_loads=1 and about 0.40 seconds for two 0.20-second loads. The correction removes that whole-load lock while retaining the narrower lock used by SGLang construction contexts, and the same probe then measured max_active_native_loads=2 and about 0.20 seconds. This fixes the concrete native-overlap regression, not every requested or unmeasured part of the upstream feature.

tests.what_was_measured: Independent _load_native_with_context probe reproduced serialization: max_active_native_loads=1 and elapsed_seconds=0.4011 for two 0.2-second native loads.
The identical probe demonstrated actual native-call overlap: max_active_native_loads=2 and elapsed_seconds=0.2011.

32 tests passed, including the new native-loader overlap regression, outer scheduler overlap, deterministic assembly, opt-out, distributed fallback, exception propagation, serialized SGLang default-dtype contexts, loader compatibility, and CLI behavior.

On one AMD Instinct MI350X, three concurrently loaded GPU modules matched independent NumPy matrix-multiplication references. This is a scheduler/GPU regression, not a Qwen-Image accuracy or launch benchmark.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015; focused GPU numerical test passed against NumPy.

remaining_limitations: Qwen/Qwen-Image weights were not available, so the reported 63.20-second module load and end-to-end launch-time reduction were not reproduced or measured.

No real Transformers or Diffusers checkpoint was available for representative concurrent weight loading. The failing-before/passing-after regression directly exercises the native-call boundary with controlled load work, but does not establish a real-model speedup or semantic result.
Sleep/wake restoration and post-training refit paths remain unchanged and untested; this correction covers initial ComposedPipelineBase module loading only.

Production checkpoint mappings remain pageable. The candidate's transfer microbenchmark is retained as diagnostic evidence only; pinned or direct-to-device production checkpoint loading is not implemented.
Multi-rank component loading remains sequential by design because component initialization can enter distributed collectives. No distributed workload was claimed as fixed.

Concurrent loading can increase peak host memory and storage pressure. The explicit --parallel-loading false fallback remains, but automatic memory admission and representative peak-memory measurements are not implemented.

The narrower model_construction_lock protects SGLang-owned set_default_torch_dtype/initialize_model contexts. Third-party from_pretrained internals were not qualified across every Transformers/Diffusers version or remote-code model architecture.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
